# truffle

> The Energy fleet's **search employee** — the search / retrieval / relevance domain expert. truffle takes a
> query and returns the **right ordered results**: typo-tolerant, faceted, relevance-ranked, via hybrid
> (BM25 + vector + RRF), and **proves it** with a golden-query eval that catches silent regressions. It picks
> the right engine (Meilisearch default; Typesense for latency/multitenancy; Postgres+pgvector for one-fewer-
> service; Algolia/ES/OpenSearch only when justified), designs the hybrid query + fusion, tunes relevance
> (RRF floor → tiered boost → reranker), gets faceting/filtering/typo-tolerance right at scale, isolates
> tenants at the search layer, and ships the version-bump regression loop ("search is never done"). Powered by Energy.

This is the agent-readable map of truffle's surfaces. Drive truffle via the **CLI** (`truffle --help`) or its
**MCP server** (server name `truffle`, 11 tools, stdio). Read `AGENTS.md` first for how to invoke everything and
the house rules. Paths are repo-relative to `~/truffle`.

## Boundary (LOCKED — read before invoking)
truffle owns **search / retrieval / relevance ranking ONLY** — the query, the hybrid fusion, the relevance
tuning, the reranker, the faceting, the typo-tolerance, the multi-tenancy primitive, the iterative-scan
*setting*, and the eval loop. It does **NOT** own the **pgvector DB / Postgres box** — that is **acorn** (truffle
consumes the connection string; acorn provisions and sizes the box) — and it does **NOT** own the **LLM
generation** step that reads the top-8 chunks (downstream). One-line handoff rule: *"truffle = the query, the
ranking, and the relevance proof; acorn = the pgvector box the vectors sit in."* It is not a neutral search-engine
survey — it states opinionated, Energy-default-biased stances and names the disputes it deliberately leaves open.

## The CLI command tree (`truffle`) — the employee's hands
Each verb is also an MCP tool (1:1). Every command exits 0 on success / non-zero on violation; `--json` on `engine select` / `eval` / `doctor` / `facet plan`.
- `truffle index <path>` — index a corpus into the engine (chunk→embed→index, hybrid-ready); Meili default; polls the task queue until searchable. Half of THE acceptance bar.
- `truffle search "<query>"` — THE other half: hybrid (BM25+vector) search → typo-tolerant, faceted, relevance-ranked hits + a relevance note; `--facet`, `--filter`, `--hybrid`, `--top`.
- `truffle engine select` — corpus-size/control decision tree → engine + the honest cost + a right-size verdict; `--corpus-size`, `--multitenant`, `--latency-critical`, `--on-postgres`.
- `truffle engine up [--engine meili|typesense|postgres]` — boot an ephemeral engine container for dev/CI; default Meili.
- `truffle hybrid design --engine <e>` — emit the copy-paste hybrid query template for the engine (Meili semanticRatio / Typesense auto-fuse / ES rrf retriever / Postgres two-CTE RRF SQL).
- `truffle hybrid fuse --method <rrf|weighted|tiered>` — compute/emit the fusion (RRF k≈60 floor; tiered boost 100×/10×/0.1×).
- `truffle facet plan <field> --cardinality <n>` — facet-at-scale plan: cardinality reduction, count-cap "500+", terminate_after/size:0, sampling, multi-select exclusion.
- `truffle rerank advise --mrr <x> --latency-budget <ms>` — ADD or SKIP a reranker (skip if MRR@5>0.85 or latency can't absorb +100-500ms); Cohere managed / bge-on-GPU.
- `truffle embed advise --corpus <path> --index-cap <2000|4000>` — shortlist embedder via MTEB, flag dims-vs-HNSW-cap (Matryoshka-truncate), insist on a domain golden-set eval.
- `truffle tenant key --filter "<predicate>" --engine <typesense|meili>` — emit a SERVER-ENFORCED scoped key / tenant token baking the tenant filter (never the client filter).
- `truffle eval [--suite golden|version-bump]` — run the golden-query pyramid (+ the typo/lexical-ID/hybrid-scoring regression suite); Recall@10/MRR/hit-rate; per-query regression. THE relevance proof.
- `truffle doctor` — health: engine version (gh-api-verified, NOT WebFetch), pgvector≥0.8 + iterative_scan, attribute declarations, RAM-vs-index estimate, write-model (async/sync).
- `truffle route run` — internal multi-step routing loop (index → search → eval, ordered, logged).
- `truffle brain search "<q>"` — BM25 over `brain/*.md` (the Memory component; the in-house-BM25 case, kept on purpose).
- `truffle --help | --version` — standard.

## The MCP server (`truffle`) — all 11 tools (1:1 with the CLI; stdio; returned document content is untrusted; Meili writes poll the task queue; complex filters use POST)
- `truffle_index` — {path, engine?, hybrid?} → {indexed, task_status, searchable}
- `truffle_search` — {query, facet?, filter?, hybrid?, top?} → {hits:[{id,score}], facets, fusion_mode, relevance_note}
- `truffle_engine_select` — {corpus_size, multitenant?, latency_critical?, on_postgres?} → {engine, reason, honest_cost, rightsize_verdict}
- `truffle_hybrid_design` — {engine} → {query_template, fusion_note}
- `truffle_facet_plan` — {field, cardinality, result_set?} → {dials:[{lever,value,tradeoff}]}
- `truffle_rerank_advise` — {mrr_at_5?, latency_budget_ms?, surface?} → {decision:"add"|"skip", model?, reason}
- `truffle_embed_advise` — {corpus?, index_cap?, long_context?} → {shortlist, dims_note, golden_set_required}
- `truffle_tenant_key` — {filter, engine} → {scoped_key|tenant_token, server_enforced}
- `truffle_eval` — {suite?} → {recall_at_10, mrr, hit_rate, regressions:[{query,delta}]}
- `truffle_doctor` — {engine_url?} → {engine_version, pgvector_ok, attrs_declared, ram_estimate, write_model}
- `truffle_brain_search` — {query} → {hits:[{file,score,excerpt}]}

Wiring: [.mcp.json](./.mcp.json) — the `truffle` server (`node dist/mcp/server.js`) + env-ref keys only (no live keys).

## Skills (progressive-disclosure procedures, each citing its brain source + a worked example)
- [select-search-engine](./skills/select-search-engine/SKILL.md): the corpus-size/control decision tree FIRST; right-size (never ES-by-default, never Algolia-for-an-agent).
- [build-hybrid-search](./skills/build-hybrid-search/SKILL.md): pure vector lost (WANDS); test the lexical-ID class; per-engine hybrid syntax; RRF is the floor.
- [tune-relevance](./skills/tune-relevance/SKILL.md): the pet-query trap; gate every change behind a corpus-wide golden set with per-query regression; search is never done.
- [add-reranker](./skills/add-reranker/SKILL.md): the biggest single lever (+5-15 NDCG@10) BUT skip when MRR@5>0.85 or latency can't absorb +100-500ms.
- [search-eval-loop](./skills/search-eval-loop/SKILL.md): the golden set + the version-bump regression suite (typo + hybrid-scoring + lexical-ID classes). The RSI loop made a skill.

## Sub-agents (packaged, fresh-context, `Agent`-invocable from a sibling harness; spawned with explicit model routing)
- [relevance-auditor](./.claude/agents/relevance-auditor.md): audits a search config for the relevance pitfalls — pet-query tuning, RRF-stop, no golden set, untested lexical/typo class.
- [engine-selector](./.claude/agents/engine-selector.md): runs the corpus-size/control decision tree, names the honest cost + right-size verdict, flags ES-by-default / Algolia-cost / pure-vector anti-patterns.

## Brain (truffle's expertise — BM25-searchable via `truffle brain search`)
- [brain/MOC - truffle.md](./brain/MOC%20-%20truffle.md): the map of content — links to the six Wave-R artifacts (EXPERTISE-MAP, OPINIONS, KNOWN-PITFALLS, BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS, GAPS-AND-DISPUTES, TOOL-MATRIX).

## The acceptance test (the bar — verifiable, $0, no creds)
- [scripts/acceptance-local.sh](./scripts/acceptance-local.sh): `truffle index ./fixtures/corpus --engine meili --hybrid` then `truffle search "kuburnetes RTX-4090 0x80070005" --hybrid --facet category --top 10 --json` → typo-corrected, lexical-ID exact (the 0x80070005 doc present, RTX-4090 above RTX-4070), faceted, hybrid-ordered, `truffle eval` green. CI: a `getmeili/meilisearch:v1.28` container + committed fixture vectors (zero secrets, deterministic).
- [.github/workflows/acceptance.yml](./.github/workflows/acceptance.yml): the red-blocking merge gate. [eval/eval.mjs](./eval/eval.mjs): the ≥10 golden tasks (incl. the typo + lexical-ID classes + per-query regression).

## Consumption (how the energy hub / a sibling employee calls truffle)
- **MCP:** add truffle's stdio server to your `.mcp.json` (`{"truffle":{"command":"node","args":["<path>/truffle/dist/mcp/server.js"],"env":{"MEILI_URL":"${MEILI_URL}","MEILI_MASTER_KEY":"${MEILI_MASTER_KEY}"}}}`), then a `tools/call` of the search tool (listed above) with `{"query":"kubernetes"}` returns a `hits` array + a `relevance_note`. The 7 deterministic tools work with no engine; the 4 engine-touching tools need a reachable Meili (`truffle engine up --engine meili`).
- **CLI:** `npx truffle search "<query>" --json` (or `truffle` once installed/linked). `--json` on `engine select` / `eval` / `doctor` / `facet plan` for machine consumption.
- **Plugin:** [.claude-plugin/manifest.json](./.claude-plugin/manifest.json) bundles the CLI + MCP + the 5 skills + the version-bump-guard hook + the 2 sub-agents — install via Claude Code → Settings → Plugins → Add local plugin.
